It’s time to experience the power of Braze! This article reveals why innovative companies are ditching SFMC for a more intuitive, agile, and future-proof platform. Discover how Braze can help you move faster with a user-friendly interface, stay ahead of the curve with its adaptable architecture, and deliver personalised experiences in real-time across all channels. While Salesforce is widely recognised for its powerful sales and services solutions, businesses have been upgrading their Customer Engagement capabilities with the implementation of Braze instead of Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) in order to move faster and be more agile. Why are marketing teams switching? Massive Rocket has deployed Braze +150 times over the last 6 years. Over the years, we continuously see teams moving over to Braze. Marketing teams are switching to Braze because it simply makes their lives easier and their work more impactful. Braze’s intuitive design empowers them to build campaigns efficiently, while its flexible architecture allows them to adapt to the ever-changing marketing landscape. Braze just works. Braze simply works because it’s built for the way modern marketers operate. Its intuitive interface empowers teams to be more efficient and creative, while its flexible architecture ensures you’re not locked into outdated technology. 1. Intuitive User Interface. Campaign Managers love Braze and therefore, they do great work. Braze offers a user-friendly interface designed specifically to empower modern CRM teams to work efficiently and unleash their creativity. Braze’s UI enables teams to move quickly and effectively in their marketing efforts. 2. Future-proof architecture. One of the standout features of Braze is its forward-thinking architecture and technology. It is built to seamlessly integrate with evolving ecosystems, ensuring compatibility and adaptability over time. By avoiding vendor lock-in, businesses can maintain flexibility and keep up with emerging trends. 3. Support for real-time use cases across all channels. Braze has strategically developed its infrastructure from the ground up to handle real-time data streaming from multiple sources. This means that businesses can rely on Braze to deliver personalised marketing messages at scale, even within the most complex environments and channels. Planning Your Migration to Braze ESP Migrating to Braze is a structured process that typically unfolds in several phases. It starts with a discovery phase to understand your business goals and current setup. This is followed by a detailed audit of your existing campaigns and data. Next, you’ll plan and set up your Braze environment, including “warming up” your IP addresses to ensure good email deliverability. Then comes the actual migration of your campaigns and data, followed by thorough testing. Finally, you’ll launch your Braze campaigns and continue to monitor and optimise them. The entire process can take anywhere from 30 to 180 days, but with expert help and the right tools, it can be significantly faster and smoother. Planning Your Migration to Braze ESP This guide offers a comprehensive overview of migrating to Braze, covering key considerations, best practices, and strategies for success. Read more: https://insights.massiverocket.com/planning-your-migration-to-braze-esp/ Salesforce to Braze connector Built by Massive Rocket. Forward-thinking companies continue to leverage the core products offered by Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud) while integrating Braze instead of SFMC to accelerate their marketing efforts. Designed to streamline and expedite the integration process between Salesforce Sales Cloud and Braze, this connector empowers businesses to seamlessly bridge the gap and leverage the combined power of Braze and Salesforce. With this innovative solution, organisations can unlock new possibilities, enhance their marketing capabilities, and optimise their customer engagement strategies. Salesforce to Braze connector The Salesforce to Braze Connector, available on the Salesforce AppExchange, is a tool designed to make your transition from Salesforce Sales Cloud to Braze smoother. Developed by Massive Rocket, this connector allows for seamless data synchronisation between the two platforms. This means your customer data can be easily transferred to Braze, accelerating your migration and minimising disruptions to your operations. Read more: https://insights.massiverocket.com/massive-rocket-unveils-braze-to-salesforce-connector/ Building a CDP for your Braze Project Building a CDP for your Braze project is like creating a central hub for all your customer data. Instead of having scattered pieces of information, you get a complete picture of each individual. This allows you to understand their behaviours, preferences, and how they interact with your brand across different channels. With this deeper understanding, you can use Braze to deliver truly personalised experiences at every step of the customer journey, making your marketing much more effective. Building a CDP for your Braze Project This white paper explores the strategic value of integrating (or building) a Customer Data Platform (CDP) for your Braze implementation to address common challenges faced by companies leveraging Braze for customer engagement. Read more: https://insights.massiverocket.com/building-a-cdp-for-your-braze-project/ Salesforce’s CDP When considering Salesforce CDP, it’s important to be aware of some potential drawbacks. It seems to fall short of expectations, with features not working as advertised. It can create data silos because it only works with data already in Salesforce. Integrating it with your data warehouse can be a real headache, and you’ll have limited options for using your data outside of the Salesforce ecosystem. It can also be slow, inflexible, and expensive to implement. You might want to explore alternative approaches like a “Composable CDP” that leverages your existing data warehouse and tools like Hightouch . Shortcomings of Salesforce’s CDP This blog examines Data Cloud’s shortcomings based on experiences from real customers using it, dig deeper into how it works, and offer some guidance for the best ways to actually marry a CDP with Salesforce Sales and Marketing Clouds. Read more: https://hightouch.com/blog/broken-promises-salesforce-cdp Leave behind the limitations of Salesforce Ready to leave behind the limitations of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and embrace the future of customer engagement? Braze empowers you to create truly personalised experiences, drive meaningful connections, and achieve your marketing goals with a platform that’s as powerful as it is intuitive. Contact Massive Rocket today to start your Braze migration and unlock the full potential of your customer data. About Braze Braze is a leading customer engagement platform that powers lasting connections between consumers and brands they love. Braze allows any marketer to collect and take action on any amount of data from any source, so they can creatively engage with customers in real time, across channels from one platform. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered experimentation and optimization, Braze enables companies to build and maintain absolutely engaging relationships with their customers that foster growth and loyalty.
